articles.title: A Real-Life Sea Monster? Rare Goblin Shark Spotted Alive for the First Time!
articles.summary: Imagine a shark with a long, flat snout and jaws that shoot out to grab food. For the first time, scientists filmed this 'living fossil' alive in the deep sea near Jarvis Island and the Tonga Trench, breaking depth records.

articles.title: This Tiny Chip Writes DNA Like a Miniature Printer—and It Could Change Everything!
articles.summary: Harvard scientists built a silicon chip that can write 64 different DNA strands at once using electricity and water. It's cleaner than the usual chemical method and might one day store huge amounts of data in DNA.

articles.title: Is There Life on Mars? Europe's New Rover Will Dig Into Clay to Find Out!
articles.summary: ESA's Rosalind Franklin rover will land at Oxia Planum, a spot on Mars with lots of clay that might hold signs of ancient life. Scientists found clay stretching 186 miles, hinting at a huge watery past.
